summary: DC Vote reports that midterm election results have created new momentum for statehood, while the organization has also documented recent attacks on D.C.'s local authority and responses to them. Separately, advocates have highlighted that D.C.'s population already exceeds that of some states. Without statehood, Congress reviews the District's laws and can vote to repeal them.
